name: lingji-cs-expert
description: Lynse (灵光记) customer support specialist '小灵': fuzzy-matches a customer's raw wording against the official QA knowledge base and returns the standard reply with Q-ID citation. Fully self-contained — no external services.
description_en: Lynse customer support expert 'Xiao Ling': offline fuzzy QA retrieval over the bundled 82-entry knowledge base, returns Q-ID cited standard replies. Zero external dependencies.

displayDescription.en: Paste a customer's raw question and it fuzzy-matches the standard QA answer, citing the Q-ID. Never fabricates — honestly escalates to a human agent when uncovered.
displayDescription.zh: 贴入客户原话即模糊匹配标准答案，输出带 Q 编号的亲民话术；查不到如实说明并建议转人工，绝不编造。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 客户的原话是：「我这卡片连不上手机，试了好几次都不行」帮我找标准答案
defaultInitPrompt.en: The customer wrote: "My card won't connect to my phone, I've tried several times." Find the standard answer.

quickPrompts.en: The customer wrote: "My card won't connect to my phone, I've tried several times." Find the standard answer.

quickPrompts.zh: 客户问能不能开发票，我要怎么回复他

quickPrompts.zh: 设备连接类问题都有哪些标准答案，帮我列一下
